title: diasperus rufoglaucus
intro: Diasperus rufoglaucus, commonly known as the "Rough Boxwood", is a plant species native to Australia. This plant is prized for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Diasperus rufoglaucus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
